description: ONS publishes half-hourly marginal operating cost, the cost of meeting an additional unit of electricity demand. DESSEM estimates costs at individual system buses; the published subsystem cost is a load-weighted average under a uniform proportional load increase. The dictionary supplies subsystem, timestamp and cost in R$/MWh. These are model outputs for dispatch and economic analysis, not observed market prices or a downloadable copy of DESSEM. Coverage is electricity subsystems in Brazil. The catalogue lists CSV, Excel and Parquet files; files are free under the provider's CC-BY terms, with no version specified. ONS requires attribution and disclosure of changes. Data contents were not downloaded; completeness is unknown, and published values may be revised. Related ONS generation-by-plant data provide a comparison series.
